identificationModule.officialTitle: CD19+Targeted CAR-T Cell Therapy for Relapsed/Refractory CD19+ B Cell Leukemia and Lymphoma

descriptionModule.detailedDescription: There are limited options for treatment of relapse/refractory B Cell Leukemia and Lymphoma.CD19 is expressed on most B Cell Leukemia and Lymphoma cells so it is an ideal target for CAR-T. In this study, investigators will evaluate the safety and efficacy of CAR-T targeting CD19 in patients with elapsed/refractory CD19+ B Cell Leukemia and Lymphoma. The primary goal is safety and efficiency assessment, including adverse events and disease status after treatment.

primaryOutcomes.measure: Adverse events that related to treatment
primaryOutcomes.description: Therapy-related adverse events will be recorded and assessed according to the National Cancer Institute's Common Terminology Criteria for Adverse Events (CTCAE, Version 5.0)

primaryOutcomes.measure: The response rate of CD19 CAR-T treatment in patients with relapse/refractory B Cell Leukemia and Lymphoma that treatment by CD19 CAR-T cells therapy
primaryOutcomes.description: The response rate of CD19 CAR-T treatment will be recorded and assessed according to the National Comprehensive Cancer Network Guideline

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Rate of CD19 CAR-T cells in bone marrow and peripheral blood
secondaryOutcomes.description: In vivo (bone marrow and peripheral blood) rate of CD19 CAR-T cells were determined by means of flow cytometry

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Quantity of CD19 CAR copies in bone marrow and peripheral blood
secondaryOutcomes.description: In vivo (bone marrow and peripheral blood) quantity of CD19 CAR copies were determined by means of qPCR

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Cellular kinetics of CD19 positive cells in bone marrow
secondaryOutcomes.description: In vivo (bone marrow) rate and quantity of CD19 positive cells were determined by means of flow cytometry

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Duration of Response (DOR) of CD19 CAR-T treatment in patients with refractory/relapsed B Cell Leukemia and Lymphoma
secondaryOutcomes.description: DOR will be assessed from the first assessment of CR or CRi to the first assessment of recurrence or progression of the disease or death from any cause (censored)

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Progress-free survival(PFS) of CD19 CAR-T treatment in patients with refractory/relapsed B Cell Leukemia and Lymphoma
secondaryOutcomes.description: PFS will be assessed from the first CAR-T cell infusion to death from any cause or the first assessment of progression (censored)

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Overall survival(OS) of CD19 CAR-T treatment in patients with refractory/relapsed B Cell Leukemia and Lymphoma
secondaryOutcomes.description: OS will be assessed from the first CAR-T cell infusion to death from any cause (censored)
